new_results: QFORM-HUB-DENSITY-AUGMENTED-BL-v1: keep the actual grouped-hub density as an auxiliary BL row. If physical augmented leverages cj<=1/2, then |phi_T(t)|<=min(1,K|t|^{-(3/2-c0)}); for c0<1/2 this yields an explicit Linfinity bound, while c0=1/2 still yields a finite whole-copy half-Riesz collision integral.

In the one-sided right-plane packet h_R=beta v+m q, with eta_j=v_j^2+q_j^2 and delta_j=h_j^2/||h_R||^2, the augmented leverages are exactly c0=x/(1+x), cj=(eta_j+x delta_j)/(1+x). The strict obstruction is eta_j+delta_j>=1, equivalently the normalized square coefficient dominates the normalized deletion area.
Target-homogeneous strict branch: if x_*<1 then ||p_Q||inf<=C_aug(x)/s3(A) for every x in [x_*,1). Numerical examples: C_aug(1/2)=30.056, C_aug(3/4)=64.430, C_aug(7/8)=133.456, C_aug(15/16)=271.625.

Critical dependence-safe collision endpoint: under eta_j+delta_j<=1 for every row, int |t|^-1/2|phi_Q(t)|^2 dt <19.646 s3(A)^-1/2, equivalently E|Q-Q'|^-1/2<7.838 s3(A)^-1/2. No sum/difference independence is used.

Splicing partner r27 with theta=1/16 and x0=15/16 pays every heavy state by <=128sqrt(15)/s3 unless some row satisfies |h_j|<rho/16, eta_j>1969/2048, and deletion-area ratio sqrt(det(B_-j^TB_-j))/m<sqrt(79/2048). Exact zero deletion area is already paid by B14 r27.
remaining_implication: QFORM-HEAVY-ROW-STRICT-NEAR-COLOOP-AGGREGATE-v2: combine the exact-coloop real-space localization with the critical augmented-BL whole-copy estimate before any conditional fiber supremum, retaining the small nonzero residual right-plane direction inside the original product bank and keeping a uniform constant as deletion area tends to zero.
